thread:
mike: FYI escalation from AcmeCorp — they requested a mid-cycle downgrade yesterday, asked to pay by PO but our system created an invoice and charged the card. Card initially declined, retried, then succeeded. Now they want a prorated credit note applied to the PO instead of a refund to card. can someone take?

jessica: account id + invoice id? need those to start docs/audit.

mike: acct: ACME-4412, invoice: inv_2026_0421_77, charge id: ch_8f9b7a. amount charged: $12,000; expected prorated charge for new plan: $4,800. so customer expects credit note ~ $7,200 (incl VAT?) they flagged VAT line looks wrong on invoice.

billing-bot: Invoice inv_2026_0421_77 created by billing-service at 2026-04-21T09:12:03Z. Tax lines computed with region=EU-VAT.

jessica: thanks. tagging @oliver (finance).

mike: customer says procurement cannot accept refunds to card — they require a credit note applied to the PO referencing the original invoice number.

oliver: quick policy note — standard is to issue a credit note for invoiced customers and apply it to the next invoice tied to the PO. we can do a manual payout only with VP approval for enterprise. do we have an active PO on file for ACME-4412?

mike: PO uploaded yesterday: PO-ACME-2026-04. procurement provided net-30 terms. but the checkout flow ignored PO header because card was present — looks like precedence rule favored immediate payment.

anna: GL and tax details please. if we issue credit note we need revenue account, tax code, and original invoice reference. also need to know if VAT was double-counted in proration calc.

mike: attaching snippet from invoice export: ```
invoice_id: inv_2026_0421_77
line_items:
  - plan: premium-eu monthly
    qty: 1
    unit_price: 12000
    period: 2026-04-01 - 2026-04-30
proration_applied: true
prorated_amount: 4800
vatrate: 20%
tax_total: 2400
charge_total: 12000
```

jessica: looks like proration_applied=true but the line items still show full month price in unit_price. is the prorated_amount field computed separately but not reflected in the taxable base?

kevin: filing note from eng — there is a known edge-case where day-based proration uses the full-item price to compute tax then subtracts credit, which can double-count VAT in the tax_total field for proration credits. repro: 1) create monthly invoice for EU customer; 2) apply mid-cycle downgrade; 3) system creates credit line but computes tax on full-month unit_price and subtracts net credit, leaving tax overstated. I can reproduce locally. logs: billing-service/proration/calc delta shows tax_base=12000 not 4800.

oliver: that matches the customer's VAT complaint. we need two things: (A) immediate remediation for this customer (correct credit note + either apply to PO or manual refund per procurement rules), (B) fix proration calculation to ensure tax base uses prorated portion before computing tax.

anna: for remediation I recommend: 1) create credit note referencing inv_2026_0421_77 with amount 7200 (net credit) and VAT 1440 (20% on 7200) so credit note total = 8640, 2) apply credit to the PO so next invoice consumes it, 3) if customer insists on cash refund for the $7200 net we need VP approval — queueing that.

mike: customer wants credit note applied to PO, not refund. procurement confirmed they will accept. can finance create credit note and update invoice so their ERP picks it up?

jessica: will start ticket with finance ops. Oliver, can you confirm the exact credit_note_id format and whether applying credit to an open PO requires any special reference string for their ERP?

oliver: credit note id will be cn_2026_0421_09. ERP needs external_reference set to PO-ACME-2026-04 and original_invoice inv_2026_0421_77. I'll prepare and sign off.

kevin: for the longer fix, I'll open a billing-service PR to change proration tax_base calculation to use prorated_amount as base, not full unit_price. estimate: 3-day fix + 1-day deploy, then we need a reconciliation job to detect affected invoices. I can add detection rule to flag invoices where proration_applied=true and tax_total != expected_tax.

anna: GL mapping: revenue_account = 4002, credit_account = 2201, tax_account = 2105. I'll add to finance ops ticket.

mike: next steps agreed: (1) oliver create credit note cn_2026_0421_09 and attach external_reference=PO-ACME-2026-04 by EOD today, (2) finance apply credit to customer account and confirm ERP export, (3) kevin patch proration tax calc and add detection job, (4) support to send customer templated confirmation with credit note and expected adjustment.

jessica: I'll send the confirmation email once finance confirms.

oliver: creating CN now. tagging @anna for GL verification. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Credit note cn_2026_0421_09 created by finance-ops at 2026-04-21T16:34:10Z referencing inv_2026_0421_77 and PO-ACME-2026-04.

anna: verified GL mapping, tax lines look correct now (net 7200, VAT 1440).

kevin: opened PR #842 in billing-service. added detection job stub to infra. will coordinate deploy with eng-oncall.

mike: customer replied: "thanks — we'll accept the credit note and apply to next PO invoice. please send official CN PDF and ERP reference." I'll follow up after we get CN PDF.

jessica: marking done on support side once CN PDF is uploaded to the ticket.

oliver: will upload PDF to the customer portal and export to ERP tonight. ETA 2 hours.

mike: thanks all. moving to resolved for this thread but keeping follow-ups in the finance ticket.
